description: pyright-autoconfig: SessionStart drops a locally-git-ignored pyrightconfig.json in Python projects lacking one, so the Pyright LSP resolves the venv and stops flooding reportMissingImports. Retracts that file if the project later declares its own [tool.pyright], because Pyright ranks pyrightconfig.json above pyproject.toml. Side-effect only, except for a one-time notice when it retracts.
